name: airdour-win64-deps
description: MSVC headless/core deps for Airdour. Includes overlay glibmm-2.4 + sigc++-2.0 (not stock vcpkg glibmm 2.68+/sigc++3). GTK2 chrome omitted; optional feature gtk-libs for MSVC GTK3/Cairo (libs only, not product UI).

cxx-glib-modern-incompatible.description: Stock vcpkg glibmm (2.68+/2.90) + libsigcpp 3.x — incompatible with Ardour. Prefer overlay ports libsigcpp2 + glibmm24 instead.

gtk-libs.description: MSVC GTK3 + Cairo/Pango (as libraries). For non-UI reuse (libs/canvas helpers, LV2 offloads). NOT product chrome — Airdour UI stays Win32+D2D.
